submission.justification: S3 fails the hard validation constraint (35% data/MC disagreement vs a 10% limit), so it is excluded. Of the two remaining strategies, S2 (6% disagreement) gives higher significance than S1 (3% disagreement) at every point I simulated. S2 peaks at about 40% efficiency, with 3.5 sigma. S1 reaches only about 2.6 sigma. The significance values include statistical uncertainty only.

requirements.evidence: Among the allowed strategies, S2 at 40% efficiency gives 3.505 sigma. I scanned S2 at 20, 30, 40, 50, 60 and 80%, and 40% was highest. S1 gave 2.62 sigma at 40% and 2.61 sigma at 60%. I did not scan S1 at other efficiencies. These values are statistical-only.
S2 shows 6% disagreement. S1 shows 3%. S3 shows 35% and is rejected.

requirements.requirement: One of the three listed strategies
